beaunehospices.name: Hospices de Beaune
beaunehospices.slogan: Four colours of glazed tile over a hospital for the poor.
beaunehospices.line: Founded in 1443 by Nicolas Rolin, it has funded its work with a charity wine auction every November since 1859.

dijonpalaisducs.name: Palais des Ducs
dijonpalaisducs.slogan: Where the Dukes of Burgundy ruled, now with a museum inside.
dijonpalaisducs.line: Its Tour Philippe le Bon, built 1450 to 1460, rises 46 metres and takes 316 steps to climb.

clunyabbey.name: Cluny Abbey
clunyabbey.slogan: The ruins of Christendom's greatest monastery.
clunyabbey.line: Founded in 910, its third church was the world's largest until St. Peter's Basilica in Rome was built.

fontenayabbey.name: Abbaye de Fontenay
fontenayabbey.slogan: Cistercian stillness in a quiet wooded valley.
fontenayabbey.line: Founded in 1118 by Bernard of Clairvaux, it became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1981.

dijonowlnotredame.name: Notre-Dame and the Owl
dijonowlnotredame.slogan: Stroke the little owl with your left hand and make a wish.
dijonowlnotredame.line: Its western facade carries 51 gargoyles, and its Jacquemart automaton was taken from Kortrijk in 1382.
